issue_context.title: Provide a Higher Performance LFU Cache Implementation for Statscache
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, our statscache uses a single lock to protect thread safety, but due to the nature of locks, performance is poor. Therefore, we would like to provide a higher performance LRU cache implementation for statscache.
Our solution is to use sharding map and LFU to implement LRU cache. This way, we can avoid using a single global lock and instead shard the cache and use individual locks for each shard. This can improve concurrency performance and cache efficiency. At the same time, the LFU algorithm can better adapt to the data access pattern and improve cache hit rate.
We plan to implement this new LRU cache implementation in the next release and would appreciate your feedback and suggestions.
